title: The Frozen Current Compendium
summary: A compendium that joins frost to flowing water until the water sets in the act of moving and carries the weight of ice and the reach of a current.

title: A Treatise of Fire Held in Frost
summary: A treatise on holding flame and frost against each other at one point so that the boundary between them breaks guards and cures fevers.

title: The Mirrorwater Doctrine
summary: A doctrine that freezes still water into clear glass-ice from the formed core so that it binds and wards and throws back what strikes it.
